name: Galaxy Angel EX
original_name: ギャラクシーエンジェル EX
source:
Contains multiple mini-games a completely new scenario Kurukuru Cool Crimson.

During a mission break angels play games and enjoy their holidays. and tact were playing in the whale room without a sort order. But after some time they look at the clock and it's again the beginning of the day off. It turns out that time shift is caused by the star called “Crimson GM075”. Will free time never end?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作包含多个小游戏，以及全新剧情《Kurukuru Cool Crimson》。

任务休整期间，天使们玩游戏、享受假期，塔克特也在鲸鱼房间里漫无目的地消磨时间。可是过了一阵子，他们看向时钟，发现时间竟又回到休息日的开端。原来，时间错位是名为“Crimson GM075”的星体造成的。难道这段自由时光永远不会结束？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
